description: Three parabolic oscillators sharing one feedback loop and mixed to a single output

params.text: Sets the pitch of all three oscillators together, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Offsets that oscillator from the first, two octaves either side of it
Sets how much of that oscillator goes into the shared feedback rather than to the output, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: Moves all three oscillators one octave per volt

outputs.text: The three oscillators added together, each at the share its own feedback knob leaves for the output

notes: the feedback knobs trade output for feedback: at 100 per cent an oscillator adds nothing directly to the output and only drives the shared loop, which phase modulates all three

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
